title: perityle scopulorum
intro: Perityle scopulorum, commonly known as Hill's cholla, is a cactus species native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Perityle scopulorum include wound healing and antimicrobial activity, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. These constituents are believed to contribute to the plant's potential therapeutic applications in treating skin conditions and infections.
